milestones.title: Project Initialization
milestones.description: Scaffold the backend foundation with clean structure and a health check endpoint.

tasks.title: Project Setup & Structure
tasks.goal: Scaffold the backend with a clean entry point separate from business logic, and expose a working GET /health endpoint.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Health endpoint returns 200 with a JSON body; app boots without errors; dependency manifest is committed and reproducible.
tasks.approachIntent: Standard tooling (NestJS/Spring/ASP.NET/Gin) with documented start script; entry point is thin (just bootstrap) while logic lives in controllers/handlers; package.json/pom.xml/.csproj/go.mod committed.

milestones.title: Environment Configuration & Logging
milestones.description: Build a centralized, fail-fast config layer and structured JSON logging with request tracing.

tasks.title: Typed Configuration Layer
tasks.goal: Centralize all environment variables into one typed, validated config object that fails fast on startup.
tasks.outcomeIntent: App crashes on boot with a clear error when a required variable is missing; PORT can be overridden via env; .env.example lists all required vars.
tasks.approachIntent: Use zod/validation schema to parse and coerce types; validate at module top level (not lazily); config is the single source for all env reads; no scattered process.env.*.

tasks.title: Structured JSON Logging with Request ID
tasks.goal: Add structured JSON logging throughout the app with a unique request ID per HTTP request for tracing.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Log entries are valid JSON (not unformatted text); each request log includes a unique id; errors are logged with stack traces; logs show timestamps and log levels.
tasks.approachIntent: Use a logging library (winston/SLF4J/Serilog/logrus) that outputs JSON; inject request ID via middleware/filter on every request; include request context in log entries.

milestones.title: PostgreSQL Database Integration
milestones.description: Connect to PostgreSQL with a pooled connection and create the products table via version-controlled migration.

tasks.title: Database: Pooled Connection from Config
tasks.goal: Wire the backend to PostgreSQL via a single shared connection pool, with credentials from the config layer.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Single DataSource/connection pool is created at bootstrap; database credentials come from config (DATABASE_URL); synchronize is false.
tasks.approachIntent: Use TypeORM/Spring Data JPA/Entity Framework/GORM to create a pooled datasource; read DATABASE_URL from config layer; set synchronize=false (no auto-schema).

tasks.title: Products Table Migration
tasks.goal: Create a products table via a version-controlled migration that stores catalog items.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Migration file is committed; products table exists with id/name/price_cents/created_at columns; migration runs on app startup.
tasks.approachIntent: Write a migration (TypeORM/Flyway/EF Core Migrations/Go migrate) that creates the products table; apply with a documented command; keep migrations in version control.

tasks.title: Health: DB Readiness Probe
tasks.goal: Expose a GET /health/db endpoint that verifies the database connection is alive.
tasks.outcomeIntent: GET /health/db returns 200 {'database':'up'} when DB is reachable; returns 503 {'database':'down'} when DB is unreachable; probe reuses the existing pool.
tasks.approachIntent: Health endpoint runs SELECT 1 on the pooled connection; returns 200 on success, 503 on failure; does not open new connections per request.

milestones.title: User Authentication: Register & Login
milestones.description: Implement user registration with password hashing and JWT-based login.

tasks.title: User Entity with Password Hashing
tasks.goal: Design a users table with email (unique), hashed password, role, and created_at, created via migration.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Users table exists with email UNIQUE constraint at DB level; passwords are stored only as bcrypt/argon2 hashes; role defaults to 'user'.
tasks.approachIntent: User entity declares email with unique=true; password field stores only the hash (never plain-text); role enum defaults to USER; migration creates the table with constraints.

tasks.title: POST /auth/register Endpoint
tasks.goal: Implement user registration that hashes passwords and stores users without leaking credentials in the response.
tasks.outcomeIntent: POST /auth/register returns 200/201 and user data without password field; password is hashed before storage; duplicate email is rejected.
tasks.approachIntent: Handler takes {email, password}, hashes with bcrypt.hash(password, 12), saves the user, returns user minus the password field.

tasks.title: POST /auth/login with JWT
tasks.goal: Implement login that verifies credentials and returns a signed JWT access token.
tasks.outcomeIntent: POST /auth/login with correct credentials returns 200 and a valid JWT (sub and role in payload); wrong password/email returns 401 with no token.
tasks.approachIntent: Handler finds user by email, bcrypt.compare(plaintext, hash), on success signs JWT with @nestjs/jwt or jsonwebtoken with 15m expiry, reads secret from config.

milestones.title: JWT Refresh Token & RBAC
milestones.description: Implement refresh-token rotation and role-based access control with guards.

tasks.title: Refresh Token Rotation
tasks.goal: Add refresh-token rotation: POST /auth/refresh issues a new access+refresh pair and invalidates the old one.
tasks.outcomeIntent: POST /auth/refresh with a current refresh token returns 200 and new tokens; reusing the old token returns 401; logout revokes the token.
tasks.approachIntent: User stores bcrypt.hash(refreshToken); /auth/refresh verifies the JWT, bcrypt.compare against stored hash, issues new pair and overwrites the stored hash (rotation); logout sets hash to null.

tasks.title: POST /auth/logout Endpoint
tasks.goal: Implement logout that revokes the user's refresh token.
tasks.outcomeIntent: POST /auth/logout with a valid access token clears the refresh token; subsequent refresh with the old token returns 401.
tasks.approachIntent: Auth-guarded endpoint that sets user.hashedRefreshToken = null; any future refresh attempt with the old token fails the hash comparison.

tasks.title: RBAC Guards & Roles
tasks.goal: Add role-based access control: a customer gets 403 on an admin route, an admin gets 200, no token gets 401.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Protected admin route with customer token returns 403; with admin token returns 200; with no token returns 401.
tasks.approachIntent: JwtAuthGuard verifies token and sets req.user with role; @Roles('admin') decorator with Reflector metadata; RolesGuard runs after auth and throws ForbiddenException on role mismatch.

milestones.title: Frontend Setup — HeroUI v3 + Theme
milestones.description: Configure HeroUI v3 + Tailwind v4 + next-themes provider stack, establish the app shell with Navbar (logo, search, cart, theme toggle, user avatar), and set up dark mode with class-based theme switching.

tasks.title: HeroUI v3 + Tailwind v4 + NextThemes Provider Setup
tasks.goal: Install and configure HeroUI v3 + Tailwind v4 stack with next-themes provider wrapping the app for dark-mode support.
tasks.outcomeIntent: HeroUI/Tailwind imports available in the app + globals.css imports in order + Provider tree renders (NextThemes > HeroUI > app > Toast) + no CSS errors on page load
tasks.approachIntent: next-themes@14 wired to class-based toggling (attribute='class' defaultTheme='dark' storageKey) + HeroUI CSS imported after Tailwind + theme tokens (--accent teal #00A898, --background, --foreground, --surface) set in :root/.light/.dark in globals.css

tasks.title: App Shell & Navbar Layout (Logo, Search, Cart, Theme, Avatar)
tasks.goal: Build the app shell with a fixed Navbar showing 'App' branding, search input, cart icon with badge, theme toggle, and user avatar dropdown.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Navbar renders with HeroUI Navbar/NavbarContent/NavbarBrand/NavbarItem + Navbar stays visible across all routes + theme toggle button swaps dark/light class + cart badge updates reactively + avatar dropdown has logout item
tasks.approachIntent: HeroUI Navbar composition with slots (leftContent: brand, centerContent: search, rightContent: cart/theme/avatar) + `useTheme()` hook reads/sets theme + cart count from Zustand store + avatar menu via HeroUI Dropdown with logout action

tasks.title: Dark Mode Toggle with next-themes
tasks.goal: Implement dark-mode switching using next-themes `useTheme()` hook, persisting selection to localStorage and rendering with HeroUI theme tokens.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Clicking theme toggle switches .dark class on HTML/body + theme persists across page reloads + all HeroUI components reflect dark palette (background, text, border colors shift) + no hydration mismatch
tasks.approachIntent: NextThemesProvider defaultTheme='dark' + useTheme() in theme toggle button + Button onClick={() => setTheme(theme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark')} + theme tokens in :root/.light/.dark use oklch values (no hardcoded #hex in source code)

milestones.title: Authentication UI — Login & Register Forms
milestones.description: Build login and register forms with React Hook Form + Zod validation, HeroUI Form components, and route guards protecting authenticated pages from unauthenticated access.

tasks.title: Login Form with RHF + Zod + HeroUI
tasks.goal: Build a login form (email + password) using React Hook Form driven by Zod schema, rendered with HeroUI Form components, with field-level validation and submission to POST /auth/login.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Form blocks submit while invalid + each field shows inline error message + valid submit fires POST /auth/login exactly once + success redirects to /products + server errors surface as form-level message
tasks.approachIntent: loginSchema (Zod) with email/password fields + zodResolver + HeroUI Input with isInvalid/errorMessage props + useForm(mode='onBlur') + handleSubmit wrapper blocking invalid + try/catch on API call with serverError state for form-level feedback

tasks.title: Register Form with RHF + Zod + HeroUI
tasks.goal: Build a register form (email + password + confirm password) using React Hook Form + Zod, rendered with HeroUI, with field-level and cross-field validation (password match).
tasks.outcomeIntent: Register blocks submit if passwords don't match + each field shows inline error + valid submit fires POST /auth/register once + success redirects to login or auto-logs in + email-already-exists error surfaces
tasks.approachIntent: registerSchema (Zod) with password/confirmPassword fields + refine() for password match validation + HeroUI PasswordInput for masked input + same RHF+zodResolver wiring as login + on success redirect to /login with confirmation message or auto-login

tasks.title: Route Guards & Middleware for Protected Routes
tasks.goal: Implement route guards that redirect unauthenticated users to /login and prevent access to protected pages like /checkout, /orders, /admin.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Navigating to /checkout without token redirects to /login + auth token read from localStorage/cookies + page re-renders after login to show protected content + middleware runs on every route change with no lag
tasks.approachIntent: Middleware.ts (Next.js App Router) that checks for auth token in headers/cookies + redirects unauthorized to /login + or ProtectedRoute wrapper HOC that reads auth context + useRouter().push('/login') if no token + useEffect to check on mount to prevent hydration mismatch

milestones.title: Storefront — Product List, Filters & Details
milestones.description: Build the product storefront with TanStack Query for server state, URL-driven filters and pagination, product detail pages as RSC with Suspense, and loading/error states.

tasks.title: Product List via TanStack Query (Loading/Error/Empty States)
tasks.goal: Fetch product list from /api/products using TanStack Query with explicit loading skeleton, error with retry, and empty state; configure caching so navigation reuses cache.
tasks.outcomeIntent: isPending branch renders HeroUI Skeleton grid before data arrives + isError branch shows error message + retry button + empty branch when data=[] + caching set so back-nav reuses data + no re-fetch on every mount
tasks.approachIntent: useQuery with stable queryKey=['products'], queryFn calling GET /api/products, staleTime set to 5min + QueryClient singleton created once (useState) + render branches on isPending/isError/data.length before map + HeroUI Card/Skeleton for UI

tasks.title: Filters & Pagination Driven by URL searchParams
tasks.goal: Add category/price/sort filters and page number to URL query string so filtering is bookmarkable, shareable, and survives refresh.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Changing filter in UI updates URL searchParams (no separate form submit) + URL changes reflect immediately in product query + page reload preserves filters + pagination buttons update ?page= param + filters and sort passed to TanStack Query
tasks.approachIntent: useSearchParams() hook reading category/minPrice/maxPrice/sortBy/page + HeroUI Select/Input for filter controls + onChange updates searchParams (useRouter/push or shallow='true') + TanStack Query queryKey includes filter params + staleTime > 0 for same filter results

tasks.title: Product Detail Page as Server Component with Suspense
tasks.goal: Build product detail page as a Server Component fetching from /api/products/:id, wrapped in Suspense for streaming and proper loading state.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Product detail loads via async server fetch + Suspense boundary shows skeleton while loading + page renders once product data arrives + if product not found return 404 + images/description loaded without client-side fetch
tasks.approachIntent: Page component (no 'use client') async, fetch product in server scope + Suspense wrapper around detail content + fallback renders HeroUI Skeleton + error boundary catches 404 + use HeroUI Card/Grid to display product image/title/price/description/add-to-cart button

tasks.title: Image Optimization & Lazy Loading
tasks.goal: Use Next.js Image component for automatic lazy-loading, srcset, and format conversion; measure and document LCP/CLS impact.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Product grid images use Next.js Image (not ) + loading='lazy' set on list images + priority='true' on hero image in detail + LCP < 2.5s measured + CLS < 0.1 from layout shift
tasks.approachIntent: Import Image from 'next/image' + set width/height (prevents CLS) + sizes for responsive srcset + loading attribute + priority for above-fold + run Lighthouse to verify LCP/CLS + add PageSpeed score to README

milestones.title: Cart & Checkout — Client State + Order Form
milestones.description: Implement cart as client-side state using Zustand with localStorage persistence, build checkout form with RHF + Zod, and wire cart to order creation.

tasks.title: Cart Client State Management with Zustand + Persistence
tasks.goal: Create a Zustand store managing cart items (product, qty, price), persisting to localStorage so cart survives page reloads.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Adding product to cart updates store + cart item list persists across reloads + removing item from cart updates store and UI + cart count badge in Navbar updates reactively + clearing cart works
tasks.approachIntent: Zustand store with actions (addItem, removeItem, clearCart, updateQty) + persist middleware saving to localStorage under key 'starci-cart' + computed cartTotal/itemCount from state + useShallow for selector memoization + HeroUI List shows cart items with qty inputs

tasks.title: Add-to-Cart Button & Quantity Selection
tasks.goal: Add HeroUI Button and Input Spinner for quantity on product list/detail pages, wiring to Zustand cart store.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Product detail shows qty input (default 1) + add-to-cart button enabled only when qty > 0 + clicking add fires addItem to Zustand + success shows toast (added to cart) + button visually reflects added state
tasks.approachIntent: HeroUI Input type='number' min=1 max=stock + HeroUI Button onClick adds to cart via store.addItem(product, qty) + toast notification shows success + after add, clear qty back to 1 or redirect to cart on mobile

tasks.title: Checkout Form with Shipping & Payment (RHF + Zod)
tasks.goal: Build checkout form collecting shipping address + contact + payment method; validate all fields with Zod; submit to POST /orders.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Invalid shipping (e.g., empty name or bad email) blocks submit + each field shows inline error + valid submit fires POST /orders with cart items + success navigates to /orders/confirmation + server error surfaces as form-level message
tasks.approachIntent: checkoutSchema (Zod) with fullName/email/phone/address/city/paymentMethod fields + HeroUI Form/Input/Select + RHF useForm(zodResolver) + handleSubmit callback POST /orders + success redirect + error handling as form-level toast or div

tasks.title: Order Confirmation & Success Page
tasks.goal: Show order confirmation with order number, items summary, and total; link to orders history.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Confirmation page displays after successful POST /orders + shows order ID, items list, subtotal/tax/total + button to view all orders + button to continue shopping + page is authenticated-only (route guard)
tasks.approachIntent: Page component fetching order details from API or passed via route state + HeroUI Card to display summary + List for order items + use TanStack Query to fetch order or rely on server-side data + responsive layout with HeroUI Grid

milestones.title: UI Polish — Accessibility, i18n & Performance
milestones.description: Implement toasts and dialogs for user feedback, internationalization (i18n) with locale switching, keyboard navigation and ARIA attributes, and performance optimizations (memo, code-split, image lazy-load).

tasks.title: Toast & Dialog Components for User Feedback
tasks.goal: Implement toast notifications (add-to-cart success, form errors) and confirm dialogs (logout, remove item) using HeroUI Modal and a toast provider.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Toasts appear on add-to-cart/form success/errors + auto-dismiss after 3s + modal dialogs appear on destructive actions (logout, remove) + backdrop click or cancel button closes dialog + form submit inside dialog works
tasks.approachIntent: HeroUI Modal for dialogs + custom toast provider (or HeroUI built-in) rendering stack of toasts via Zustand store + toast.success/error/info/warning actions + dismiss button or auto-timeout + modals wire to store.logout() or store.removeItem()

tasks.title: Keyboard Navigation & ARIA Accessibility
tasks.goal: Ensure keyboard users can navigate all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, modals) with Tab, Enter, Escape; add ARIA labels and roles.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Tabbing through page focuses each button/input/link in logical order + Enter submits forms + Escape closes modals + screen readers announce button purposes (aria-label) + form errors announce as alerts + disabled buttons are skipped
tasks.approachIntent: HeroUI components already provide semantic HTML/ARIA (Button, Input, Form render with role/aria-* by default) + ensure focus visible on all buttons (browser default or Tailwind focus:outline) + test with keyboard-only and screen reader (NVDA/JAWS simulation) + add aria-label/aria-describedby where needed (icon buttons, complex regions)

tasks.title: Internationalization (i18n) with Locale Switching
tasks.goal: Add multi-language support (en/vi) using i18n library (e.g., next-i18n-router or react-i18next); allow users to switch locale via dropdown.
tasks.outcomeIntent: UI text switches between English and Vietnamese when locale changed + locale persists in localStorage + all pages/components reflect selected language + date/number formatting respects locale + RTL support if needed
tasks.approachIntent: next-i18n-router (adds /en /vi paths) or next-intl (file-based messages) + translation catalogs in public/locales/en/common.json + useTranslation() hook in components + locale dropdown in Navbar calling i18n.changeLanguage() + format dates/currency via Intl.DateTimeFormat/NumberFormat

tasks.title: Performance Optimization (React.memo, Code-Split, Bundle Analysis)
tasks.goal: Wrap heavy components in React.memo, lazy-load modals/detail pages with dynamic import, measure bundle size, and document optimization impact.
tasks.outcomeIntent: ProductCard wrapped in memo (no unnecessary re-renders on sibling updates) + Checkout page lazy-loaded with dynamic() + ProductDetail loaded on demand + bundle analyzed shows no duplicate deps + Lighthouse score >= 85 on all pages
tasks.approachIntent: Wrap ProductCard/CartItem in React.memo with custom comparison if needed + dynamic(() => import('./Checkout'), { loading: () => <Skeleton /> }) for route-based splitting + use next/bundle-analyzer to inspect final bundle + document before/after sizes + run Lighthouse in CI to catch regressions

milestones.title: Catalog API: Pagination & Caching
milestones.description: Expose GET /products pagination+filter and GET /products/:id with controller-level caching. Implement 4lang product catalog endpoints with response-time optimization.

tasks.title: Product Catalog API with Pagination
tasks.goal: Build GET /products?page=&limit=&q= returning paginated products with metadata (total, page, limit) and optional name filter.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Shape is correct: items array, total count, page/limit metadata present. Pages actually differ on pagination. Filter reduces result count correctly.
tasks.approachIntent: Pagination in DB (skip/take), optional ILIKE filter pushed to WHERE clause, bounded limit (max 100). Query params validated with DTO.

tasks.title: Product Details API with Caching
tasks.goal: Build GET /products/:id returning a single product; cache the response at controller level to reduce DB queries on repeated reads.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Details endpoint returns product by id with 200 status. Repeated reads within cache window hit cache (fewer DB queries visible in logs). Cache invalidates or has a TTL.
tasks.approachIntent: Cache decorator (NestJS @Cacheable or manual CacheManager) stores product by id. Cache key includes product id. TTL set (e.g. 5-10 min). Invalidate on update/delete.

tasks.title: Product Entity & Database Seeding
tasks.goal: Define Product entity (id, name, price_cents, stock, imageUrl, createdAt), run migrations, and seed 10+ mock products idempotently.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Table exists with all columns, correct types (price_cents integer, stock integer). Seed script inserts 10+ rows idempotently (re-run safe).
tasks.approachIntent: TypeORM/Spring Data JPA/EF Core/GORM entity with @Entity/@Table. Integer cents (never float dollars). Migration creates table. Seed upserts or truncate-insert.

milestones.title: Product Image Upload & Storage
milestones.description: Accept multipart image uploads or presigned URLs, validate type+size, persist to S3/MinIO/disk, and wire FE upload UI.

tasks.title: Product Image Upload
tasks.goal: Build POST /products/:id/image accepting multipart file, validating content-type (image/* only) and size (≤5 MB), uploading to S3/MinIO/disk, and returning stored URL.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Valid image returns 200/201 + url that resolves to the stored object. Bad uploads (oversize/non-image) return 4xx. URL persists on product GET.
tasks.approachIntent: FileInterceptor with Multer size limit + fileFilter checking image/* mime type. Upload to S3 (PutObjectCommand) or disk. Update product.imageUrl. Smoke test in README.

tasks.title: Image Upload UI with HeroUI
tasks.goal: Wire a HeroUI-based upload component in product admin/detail view: drag-drop or file input, type+size validation feedback, loading state, success/error toast.
tasks.outcomeIntent: File input or drag-drop zone renders. Upload button sends multipart POST to /products/:id/image. Type/size validation shows error toast on client. Success shows url in preview. Loading spinner visible.
tasks.approachIntent: HeroUI Input + Button + Image components. FormData multipart POST. Fetch or SWR error handling → addToast. Client-side type+size check pre-flight. Preview displays returned url.

milestones.title: Cart API & Client Sync
milestones.description: Build per-user cart API: add/update/remove items, recompute totals server-side. Wire FE cart to sync with server, merge guest carts.

tasks.title: Cart Management API
tasks.goal: Build Cart + CartItem entities and endpoints: POST /cart/items (merge duplicates), PATCH /cart/items/:productId, DELETE /cart/items/:productId, GET /cart. Validate quantities > 0. Recompute totals server-side.
tasks.outcomeIntent: GET /cart returns authenticated user's cart (auto-created empty if missing). Add/update/remove all work, reject quantity ≤ 0. Subtotals (unitPrice * qty) and total correct after every change.
tasks.approachIntent: Cart + CartItem entities persisted with user FK. Every endpoint filters by userId. Total recomputed via reduce(unitPrice * qty). Validation with @IsInt @Min(1) guards 400 on bad quantity.

tasks.title: Cart Client Sync & Guest Merge
tasks.goal: Wire FE cart state to GET /cart and POST/PATCH/DELETE /cart/items. On login, merge guest cart into authenticated user's server cart.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Adding to cart makes visible POST /cart/items request. Cart UI shows server totals. On login, guest items merge into user's cart (no data loss). Removing item calls DELETE /cart/items/:productId.
tasks.approachIntent: SWR/TanStack Query fetch GET /cart on mount. addToCart → optimistic update + POST /cart/items, refetch. Cart component shows server total. On auth success, merge guest → POST each item to /cart/items.

milestones.title: Order Creation & Safe Inventory Deduction
milestones.description: Transactional order creation: POST /orders creates order+items, deducts stock atomically (no oversell), rolls back on error. Wire checkout UI.

tasks.title: Order Creation within a Transaction
tasks.goal: Build POST /orders creating order + order_items + clearing cart inside ONE database transaction. Reject empty carts with 400. Snapshot prices. Recompute total server-side. Roll back on any error.
tasks.outcomeIntent: POST /orders with cart items returns 201 + new order (id, status PENDING, total, items). Empty cart rejected 400. Failed step (e.g., stock error) leaves no partial order, cart unchanged.
tasks.approachIntent: dataSource.transaction() wraps entire operation. Every write via passed-in manager (no normal repos). Create Order + OrderItems in one statement. Clear CartItems. Compute total server-side. Throw rolls back.

tasks.title: Safe Inventory Deduction
tasks.goal: Deduct product.stock atomically inside order transaction: UPDATE ... WHERE id=:id AND stock >= :qty checks if deduction is safe. Reject with 409 if insufficient. Concurrent races only succeed once.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Stock drops by exactly ordered qty on success. Over-order rejected 409, stock unchanged. Two concurrent orders for last unit: one succeeds, one rejected, final stock = 0 (not -1).
tasks.approachIntent: Conditional UPDATE (stock = stock - :q WHERE stock >= :q) with affected-row count check. 0 affected → ConflictException 409. No read-then-write race. Runs in SAME transaction manager as order insert.

tasks.title: Checkout to Order UI
tasks.goal: Wire checkout form (address, payment) → POST /orders. Show loading, handle errors (409 oversell, 400 empty), display order confirmation with id+total. Clear cart on success.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Checkout form submits POST /orders. Success shows order id + total in confirmation. 409 oversell → error toast. Empty cart → disabled checkout. Loading spinner during request.
tasks.approachIntent: Checkout form with RHF + Zod. POST /orders handler with error mapping (409 → 'Out of stock', 400 → 'Empty cart'). On success, clear cart state, show confirmation. Toast errors.

milestones.title: Order History API & Orders UI
milestones.description: Expose GET /orders and GET /orders/:id listing user's past orders. Build Orders list + detail view showing status, items, total.

tasks.title: Order History API
tasks.goal: Build GET /orders (list) and GET /orders/:id (detail) scoped to authenticated user. List is newest-first. Detail includes items. Never leak another user's orders.
tasks.outcomeIntent: GET /orders returns authenticated user's orders newest-first (status, total, createdAt). GET /orders/:id shows one order's lines + total. Requesting another's order returns 404/403 (not their data). Empty history returns 200 + empty array.
tasks.approachIntent: Both endpoints filter by userId in WHERE clause (never bare find-by-id). Detail lookup uses {id, userId}. Ownership check in DB, not client-trusted input. Ordered by createdAt DESC.

tasks.title: Orders List & Detail UI
tasks.goal: Build Orders page: list table (id, status, total, date) → detail modal/page showing line items, prices, total. Fetch GET /orders on mount, GET /orders/:id on row click.
tasks.outcomeIntent: Orders list displays 5+ order rows (status badge, total, date). Clicking row shows detail with items + prices. Detail closes/navigates back. Empty orders shows message.
tasks.approachIntent: SWR fetch GET /orders on mount. Table with rows. onClick → fetch GET /orders/:id + show detail modal or navigate to /orders/:id. Map items array to table rows.

milestones.title: Background Jobs & Notifications
milestones.description: Process orders asynchronously with a real queue (BullMQ), send templated confirmation emails/SMS, and display order processing status in the UI.

tasks.title: Background Order Processing Job
tasks.goal: Enqueue order processing onto BullMQ after checkout so the request returns immediately while a worker processes off-thread
tasks.outcomeIntent: Request returns HTTP 201 before processing completes (observable via slow worker + status check). Order status flips to processed asynchronously, verified via order-history API showing status was pending then processed.
tasks.approachIntent: BullMQ queue + NestJS @Processor worker (critical: queue connection from config, job payload is orderId-only, worker retries on DB errors, no await-blocking in handler). Job lifecycle: enqueue after commit, worker loads order, updates status, saves.

tasks.title: Order Confirmation Email/SMS
tasks.goal: When an order becomes processed, send a templated confirmation email/SMS via a provider; send failures retry silently and never crash the checkout
tasks.outcomeIntent: Confirmation email/SMS is sent to order owner with order id, items, total. Provider logs/mock shows the templated message. Send failure is retried (BullMQ retry) and does not roll back the processed order.
tasks.approachIntent: NotificationService wraps Nodemailer/SendGrid (email) + Twilio (SMS), credentials from config. Enqueue send-confirmation job from order-processed handler (not in checkout path). Worker renders template, sends, throws on error for retry.

tasks.title: Order Processing Status UI
tasks.goal: In the orders detail page, show live order processing status (pending → processing → processed) with visual indicator and timestamp
tasks.outcomeIntent: Orders list/detail shows current status badge (pending=warning, processing=info, processed=success). Status updates when order is loaded. Timestamp reflects when status last changed. Matches design: HeroUI Badge/Chip for status, teal accent on processed.
tasks.approachIntent: Order detail page queries order API (includes status + updatedAt). Display status as HeroUI Chip with color mapping (critical: pending→warning, processing→info, processed→success/teal). Show updatedAt as relative time. Poll or await real-time push in M17.

milestones.title: Realtime Order Status (WebSocket)
milestones.description: Push live order-status updates over WebSocket to the owning user; only authenticated owners receive their order's status events.

tasks.title: Real-time Order Status (WebSocket)
tasks.goal: Expose Socket.IO gateway so an authenticated user subscribes to their own order; when status changes, emit order.status event to that order's room
tasks.outcomeIntent: Authenticated client subscribes to orderId, receives order.status event when order is processed (status + updatedAt). Only the order owner's socket receives the event. Non-owner attempting to subscribe is rejected (403).
tasks.approachIntent: Socket.IO + NestJS @WebSocketGateway (critical: auth in handleConnection via token, verify order.userId == socket.userId on subscribe). Worker publishes via Redis adapter (redis-adapter for multi-process). Emit to room order:<orderId> only.

tasks.title: Realtime Orders Detail UI
tasks.goal: Orders detail page subscribes to WebSocket and displays live status updates without polling; when status event arrives, UI re-renders instantly
tasks.outcomeIntent: Orders detail page connects to Socket.IO on mount, subscribes to orderId. When order.status event is received, status badge and timestamp update in real-time without page refresh. Disconnect on unmount. Non-owner cannot see other users' orders.
tasks.approachIntent: Client Socket.IO hook subscribes on mount, calls server subscribe handler. Listen for order.status event and update local state (Zustand or React state). HeroUI Badge reflects new status instantly (critical: visual feedback, color change). Cleanup: leave room + disconnect on unmount.

milestones.title: Production Readiness
milestones.description: Add observability (logs, tracing, errors), implement end-to-end security (helmet, CORS, rate-limiting, validation), and add error UI boundaries in the frontend.

tasks.title: Observability: Logs, Tracing & Errors
tasks.goal: Make the app observable: emit structured JSON logs, wrap requests in OpenTelemetry spans with trace_id propagation, and report unhandled errors to Sentry
tasks.outcomeIntent: Logs are single-line JSON with timestamp, level, message, trace_id. POST /orders request carries a span with trace_id returned in response. Unhandled 5xx errors are captured in Sentry with trace_id and route context. 4xx validation errors are NOT sent to Sentry (no noise).
tasks.approachIntent: nestjs-pino for JSON logging (critical: trace_id in every log line). @opentelemetry/sdk-node started BEFORE app imports (node -r tracing.js), manual span in order handler exposes trace_id. @sentry/node initialized with DSN, global exception filter captures 5xx + trace_id context, ignores 4xx.

tasks.title: Security End-to-End
tasks.goal: Secure the app from common attacks: helmet headers, CORS policy, rate-limiting on sensitive endpoints, and strict input validation on all user inputs
tasks.outcomeIntent: Helmet headers present (X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, CSP). CORS allows only trusted origins. Rate-limit on /auth/login (10 req/min per IP), /orders (5 req/min per user). All POST/PATCH inputs validated against Zod schema before processing.
tasks.approachIntent: helmet() + NestJS middleware for CORS + express-rate-limit (critical: per-IP for login, per-user for orders via decorator). All DTO fields validated with @nestjs/class-validator + Zod; reject invalid before handler. Test: send oversized payload, invalid JWT, rapid requests — all rejected/limited.

tasks.title: Error UI & Toast Fallback (Frontend)
tasks.goal: Display user-friendly error messages in the UI with error boundary and toast notifications; API errors do not crash the page
tasks.outcomeIntent: API errors (4xx, 5xx) show a HeroUI toast with user-friendly message (not raw error text). 500 errors show generic message + support link. Cart/checkout errors do not unmount the page. Unhandled component errors caught by error boundary and displayed with retry button.
tasks.approachIntent: Client error boundary wraps cart/orders/checkout. API calls wrapped in try-catch + toast on error (critical: HeroUI addToast). Sentry integration captures client-side errors. Show user message, never expose stack trace. Checkout validation failures show field-level hints via RHF.

milestones.title: Testing Strategy
milestones.description: Write unit tests for order and inventory logic, an E2E test of the complete purchase flow, and document frontend functional testing.

tasks.title: Unit & E2E Testing
tasks.goal: Write unit tests for critical business logic (order creation, inventory deduction) and one E2E test of the full purchase flow (register → browse → add to cart → checkout → order created)
tasks.outcomeIntent: Unit tests cover order creation (quantity > 0, total calculated correctly, status = pending), inventory deduction (stock reduced, insufficient stock throws). E2E test registers a user, adds a product to cart, completes checkout, and asserts order is created with correct items/total. All tests pass in CI.
tasks.approachIntent: Jest for unit tests, NestJS TestingModule for integration (critical: mocked DB/queue in unit, real DB in E2E). E2E uses Playwright or Cypress to drive API calls (register, browse, checkout) and assert final state. Tests run on every commit (CI hook).

tasks.title: Frontend Functional Test Note
tasks.goal: Document the frontend smoke test checklist for the purchase journey (manual or automated via Playwright); verify the journey works with the real backend
tasks.outcomeIntent: README includes a 'Testing' section with manual test checklist: register → login → browse products → filter → view detail → add to cart → view cart → checkout → confirm order appears in orders list. Optionally: Playwright spec for the happy path (visit URL, fill forms, assert final state).
tasks.approachIntent: Write test checklist in README or a `tests/smoke.md` file (critical: step-by-step, no jargon, screenshot points). Optional: Playwright E2E test in `tests/e2e/purchase.spec.ts` that automates the checklist (visit frontend, register, checkout, assert order in orders list).

milestones.title: Deployment & Capstone: Live on VPS
milestones.description: Containerize the app, set up CI/CD with GitHub Actions, deploy to a DigitalOcean droplet with nginx reverse proxy + HTTPS via certbot, and demonstrate the full purchase journey end-to-end.

tasks.title: Dockerize Application
tasks.goal: Package the backend in a multi-stage Dockerfile and provide docker-compose.yml that boots backend + PostgreSQL together
tasks.outcomeIntent: docker compose up starts backend and database. GET /health returns 200. No secrets baked into image. Image is lean (< 200MB for Node/Postgres combined). docker compose down cleans up volumes.
tasks.approachIntent: Multi-stage Dockerfile: build stage (npm ci, npm run build) → runtime stage (node:20-alpine, npm ci --omit=dev, non-root USER). docker-compose.yml with app + db services, depends_on: condition service_healthy, env from env_file (not baked in). (critical: exec-form CMD, SIGTERM reaches node)

tasks.title: CI/CD Pipeline
tasks.goal: Automate build, test, and deploy with GitHub Actions: on push to main, run tests, build Docker image, and SSH deploy to VPS
tasks.outcomeIntent: GHA workflow runs on push: npm run test → docker build → push image to registry (or build on VPS). SSH into droplet, pull image, docker compose up -d. Workflow logs show each step. Deployment succeeds or rolls back on test failure.
tasks.approachIntent: GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/deploy.yml) with: test job (npm test), build job (docker build), deploy job (SSH into droplet, git pull, docker compose pull/up). Use GitHub Secrets for SSH_KEY, REGISTRY credentials. (critical: tests must pass before deploy, secrets never in logs)

tasks.title: VPS, Nginx Reverse Proxy & HTTPS
tasks.goal: Deploy the app on a DigitalOcean droplet, configure nginx as reverse proxy, and enable HTTPS via certbot on a custom domain
tasks.outcomeIntent: Droplet running Ubuntu 22.04. Docker + docker-compose installed. Nginx proxies :80/:443 → backend :3000 and frontend :5173. Certbot issues Let's Encrypt cert for your domain (e.g. starci-shop.example.com). HTTPS redirects HTTP. `curl https://starci-shop.example.com/health` returns 200.
tasks.approachIntent: Provision droplet (4GB RAM, 80GB SSD). Install Docker, clone repo. Nginx config: upstream backend/frontend, server blocks for HTTP → HTTPS redirect, SSL cert paths. Certbot: certbot certonly --nginx -d starci-shop.example.com (critical: renew hook in cron, ports 80/443 open in firewall). docker-compose.yml exposes ports to localhost, nginx handles external traffic.

tasks.title: End-to-End Integration
tasks.goal: Wire frontend + backend into ONE working app: the complete purchase journey runs against the real API with a single documented command to bring the whole stack up
tasks.outcomeIntent: docker compose up boots frontend + backend + database. `curl http://localhost:5173` shows the app. Purchase journey: register → browse → add to cart → checkout → order confirmation → order appears in orders list. No mocked endpoints in happy path. README documents the run.
tasks.approachIntent: Top-level docker-compose.yml with frontend, backend, database services. Frontend env: API_BASE_URL=http://backend:3000 (not hardcoded). Real API calls for register, products, cart, checkout, orders. README: 'docker compose up --build' → 'open http://localhost:5173' → test the journey.

tasks.title: Live Deployment
tasks.goal: Run the app live on the VPS with automated CI/CD: push to main, tests run, image builds, and deployment to droplet succeeds
tasks.outcomeIntent: GHA workflow passes all steps. Droplet has the latest image running. `curl https://starci-shop.example.com/health` returns 200. Frontend is accessible at https://starci-shop.example.com. API requests from frontend reach the backend. Database persists orders.
tasks.approachIntent: GHA: test → docker build → SSH deploy (git pull, docker compose up -d). Droplet firewall: 22 (SSH), 80/443 (nginx). nginx proxies https to backend/frontend. docker-compose uses named volume for Postgres data (survives restarts). Environment variables loaded from .env on droplet (not in image).

tasks.title: Capstone: Demo & Acceptance
tasks.goal: Demonstrate the complete StarCi Shop application end-to-end: register, browse products, add to cart, checkout, receive confirmation, view order history, and observe real-time status updates
tasks.outcomeIntent: README includes a 'Demo' or 'How to Run' section with: (1) how to bring up the app locally (docker compose up), (2) step-by-step purchase journey, (3) evidence of the journey (screenshots or recorded run showing register → browse → checkout → order in orders list → realtime status update). Grading reads the README and submitted evidence.
tasks.approachIntent: README structure: Project Overview → Setup (docker compose up) → Running the App (localhost:5173) → Feature Tour (auth, catalog, cart, checkout, orders, realtime) → Architecture (frontend, backend, database). Document each feature with a screenshot or user flow. Include a link to a recorded demo (Loom, etc.) or instructions to manually walk through the purchase journey.
